data.content_ref: inline:A speculative SHARED MECHANISM: Connection 0d64405bfceb posits that both the 'Decisionist Leap' (SRC_002) and the 'Risk Minimization' strategy (SRC_003) are fueled by a single underlying evolutionary drive to minimize 'surprise entropy' rather than maximize truth. The leap (SRC_002) and the strategic choice (SRC_003) are just different cognitive framings of the same entropy-reduction behavior.
